Intersecting contacts with the associated event-log Relay mode gives 178\,682~s and \textbf{428\,836\,800 bytes} ideal science-transfer opportunity. Minimum daily Relay overlap is 312~s, or 748\,800 bytes. This schedule-based upper opportunity is distinct from the original 3.514084 source-labelled MB transfer credit. Framing, losses and net-throughput qualification are deferred to PDR; no arbitrary throughput derating is applied at MCR.

The 292-byte v3 reference and three-reading preference define a concrete data interface without changing science requirements. Full 19.2~kbps Relay-intersected historical opportunity is 428\,836\,800 bytes, but its epoch/configuration cannot be matched to the grid study's 187\,498\,164-byte three-reading sensitivity. No unconditional mission data balance follows from comparing those totals. The bounded legacy-gate fixture fits a 256~KiB dedicated science queue; 128~MiB remains a preliminary rolling-storage allocation, and cannot retain the entire three-reading grid sample without delivery. Hardware memory, metadata, sustained acquisition and outage envelope remain closure conditions. RF qualification and net application throughput are PDR tasks; no arbitrary usable-link reduction is applied at MCR.

Its telemetry is incomplete at 50 days plus 20~s; its event exports reach nearly 365 days but are not a matching completion record. Table~\ref{tab:annual-ditl} summarizes telemetry contents. Exact hashes and separate artifact manifests prevent those series being pooled into an apparently complete run. The model's recorded minimum battery is 15.21520~Wh (60.8608\% of the 25~Wh planning reference); this is not an annual worst-case bound.

For the incomplete annual telemetry, total accounted time is 4\,320\,020~s; geometric SAA time is 130\,664~s; Detection-labelled SAA time is 1246~s; acquisition-gate time is 342~s. Thus model acquisition/SAA is $342/130664=0.26174\%$, not the historical detection-conditional 62.7\% fraction. Accepted physical detector exposure, reconstructed proton measurements and delivered current-FPDU records remain unqualified. Repeated time samples are not independent passages.
